new-games-a.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an eight-pose transparent game sprite sheet using the attached canonical KPop member as the exact identity reference. This member is KPop Girl LEFT: warm fair complexion, large brown eyes, rich brown hair gathered into a neat low side bun with a loose curl, powder-blue sleeveless cropped top, dark royal-blue loose trousers and white sneakers. Preserve these exact clothes and hairstyle; do not substitute the other two group members or add accessories. Preserve exact face, skin tone, hairstyle, outfit, palette, silhouette and polished navy-outlined cel-shaded finish in every pose. Exactly EIGHT separate full-body figures arranged in a 4-column by 2-row grid, read left-to-right then next row, one centered figure per cell, consistent head size and proportions, three-quarter view facing right, transparent gutters, complete hair, hands and shoes inside each cell. Row 1: (1) tug-of-war ready: feet planted, torso leaning back left, both empty hands together reaching forward-right at waist height to grip an invisible rope, determined happy grin; (2) tug heave: leaning farther back left, knees bent, same forward empty grip, cheerful exertion; (3) fishing reel ready: leaning back slightly, forward hand gripping an invisible rod just above chest height, other hand beside it preparing to crank, happy focused gaze right; (4) fishing reel crank: same stance and forward grip, other hand moved inward and down to crank an invisible reel, bright grin. Row 2: (5) overhead bat-swing windup: both empty hands together above right shoulder/overhead, legs braced, gleeful face; (6) bat-swing follow-through: both empty hands moved forward-right and upward above face, finishing a gentle overhead strike, cheerful grin; (7) putting ready: side-on facing right, knees softly bent, looking down-right, both empty hands together low in front/right at thigh height holding an invisible putter; (8) putting follow-through: same stance, low empty hands swung slightly forward-right, looking up-right hopefully. Both hands remain visibly empty in every pose. No rope, rods, fishing line, bats, putters, balls, scenery, shadows, ground, effects, text, labels, dividers, borders or background. Transparent background.

new-games-b.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a four-pose transparent game sprite sheet using the attached canonical KPop member as the exact identity reference. This member is KPop Girl LEFT: warm fair complexion, large brown eyes, rich brown hair gathered into a neat low side bun with a loose curl, powder-blue sleeveless cropped top, dark royal-blue loose trousers and white sneakers. Preserve these exact clothes and hairstyle; do not substitute the other two group members or add accessories. Preserve exact face, skin tone, hairstyle, outfit, palette, silhouette and polished navy-outlined cel-shaded finish in every pose. Exactly FOUR separate full-body figures arranged in ONE horizontal row, read left-to-right, one centered figure per cell, consistent head size/proportions, three-quarter view facing right, transparent gutters, no clipping of hair, hands or shoes. (1) spring-jump: launching joyfully upward, both arms straight up, knees tucked, feet lifted, delighted grin and upward gaze; (2) snow-scoop: deeply crouched close to ground, both empty hands together low in front/right, curved palms packing an invisible snowball, focused cheerful face, feet planted; (3) dig: low crouch, legs spread slightly, torso leaning forward/right, both hands scooping down between legs then back toward left, gleeful focused face, feet planted; (4) skip-hop: light two-footed jump-rope hop, knees tucked slightly, both arms extended out to sides around waist/chest height, joyful face, feet lifted. Keep both hands empty, no props. No snowball, tools, rope, clouds, scenery, shadows, effects, text, labels, dividers, borders or background. Transparent background.
